nodes.label: GaugeController
nodes.role: Manages gauge registry and weekly CRV emission weight votes

nodes.label: Minter
nodes.role: Mints CRV emissions to gauge stakers

nodes.label: FeeDistributor (crvUSD)
nodes.role: Current fee distributor that pays veCRV holders in crvUSD

nodes.label: FeeCollector
nodes.role: Universal admin-fee collection entry point feeding the burner/hooker pipeline

nodes.label: FeeReceiver
nodes.role: Fee receiver wired into the NG factories and crvUSD ControllerFactory

nodes.label: FeeSplitter
nodes.role: Claims fees from all crvUSD Controllers and splits crvUSD among configured receivers

nodes.label: FeeAllocator
nodes.role: Allocates crvUSD fees between receivers and the veCRV FeeDistributor

nodes.label: CowSwapBurner
nodes.role: Burns admin fees into target coin via CowSwap conditional orders

nodes.label: Hooker
nodes.role: Executes post-burn hooks; forwards target token from FeeCollector to FeeDistributor
